heading: Today
text: Some early fog. Mostly cloudy. A good chance of afternoon showers south, scattered north.

heading: Thursday Night
text: Evening showers, mostly south, ending. Partial clearing, patchy fog.

heading: Friday
text: Partly to mostly sunny, blustery, and cooler.
temperature: Low 60s to low 70s north to south

heading: Saturday
temperature: Upper 50s to mid 60s north, mid to upper 60s south
